description: Defines interfaces and classes for a Worker Pool system, including job management, scheduling, and monitoring within the WPEFramework Core namespace.

classes.name: IWorkerPool
classes.description: Interface for a worker pool managing job submission, scheduling, revocation, and snapshotting.

classes.name: WorkerPool
classes.description: Implementation of a worker pool with scheduling, job management, and optional dispatched job monitoring.

methods.name: Submit
methods.description: Submits a job to the worker pool.

methods.name: Schedule
methods.description: Schedules a job to run at a specified time.

methods.name: Reschedule
methods.description: Reschedules an existing job to a new time.

methods.name: Revoke
methods.description: Revokes a scheduled or running job.

methods.name: Join
methods.description: Waits for all jobs to complete.

methods.name: Id
methods.description: Returns the thread ID for a given index.

methods.name: Snapshot
methods.description: Returns a snapshot of the worker pool's current state.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Starts the worker pool's processing loop.
